data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to interact with Android Accessibility Service for events and actions.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to check and request accessibility permission, stream accessibility events, and perform actions or gestures via the Android accessibility service.
use_when: You need to monitor Android accessibility events (e.g., window changes, text changes)
You want to automate UI interactions on Android using accessibility actions or gestures
avoid_when: Your app targets iOS or other platforms
You need a cross‑platform solution without native Android setup
strengths: Low‑level access to Android accessibility events
Supports gesture simulation and action execution
Event stream makes reactive handling easy
weaknesses: Requires manual AndroidManifest and XML configuration
data.setup_notes: Add a <service> entry with BIND_ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE permission to AndroidManifest and create res/xml/accessibilityservice.xml; request permission at runtime.
